spots.name: Turning Torso

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Turning Torso is a neo-futurist residential skyscraper built in Malmö, Sweden, in 2005. It was the tallest building in the Nordic region until September 2022, when it was surpassed by Karlatornet in Gothenburg.

spots.name: Malmö Castle

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Malmö Castle is a medieval castle located on Slottsholmen in Malmö, Sweden. It was built between 1526 and 1539 and is thus the oldest preserved Renaissance castle in the Nordic region. Malmö Castle is part of The Malmö Museum. It is owned by the Swedish state and managed by the National Property Board.

spots.name: Malmö Central Station
spots.summary: Malmö Central Station is the main railway station serving the city of Malmö, Sweden. It is located in central Malmö, situated between the historic city centre and the Port of Malmö. Opened on the Southern Main Line in 1856, it serves approximately 17 million passengers per year.

spots.name: St. Peter's Church, Malmö

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Saint Peter's Church is a Brick Gothic church in Malmö, Sweden. Built in the 14th century as the main church of the city, it has been described as "the main Gothic monument within church architecture in Scania".

names.it: Chiesa di San Pietro di Malmö

spots.name: Stortorget
spots.summary: Stortorget is a square in Malmö. Construction began in 1538 with the demolition of The Monastery of the Holy Spirit (Heligandsklostret), which with its cemetery occupied about 70% of the area of the future square. A note in 1542 refers to the site as thet ny torg.

spots.name: Malmö Art Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Malmö Art Museum, founded in 1841, is one of the leading art museums in Scandinavia. Located within the Malmö Castle complex in Malmö, Scania, southern Sweden, its current building dates to 1937. The museum is governed by the City of Malmö.

spots.name: Lilla torg
spots.summary: Lilla Torg is a square in Gamla Staden in central Malmö, Sweden. It is located right next to Stortorget. There are a number of restaurants around the square and in the summer it is full of people on the outdoor terraces.

spots.name: Jörgen Kocks hus
spots.summary: Jörgen Kocks hus, or Kockska Huset, is a historic building complex in Malmö, Sweden. Its brick walls symbolize not only Malmö's history in the 1500s, but also a significant part of Danish history. It was built by the wealthy businessman Jörgen Kock for his family and his mint.

spots.name: Pildammsparken
spots.summary: Pildammsparken is a neighbourhood and park in Malmö, Sweden, design in a neoclassical style and covering an area of 45 hectates. The park was founded for the Baltic Exhibition of 1914, but its two dams predate it, as a reservoir for the inhabitants of Malmö.

spots.name: Gustav Adolfs torg
spots.summary: Gustav Adolfs torg is a public square located in Malmö, Sweden. It is a large park-like square located in central Malmö between Stortorget and Triangeln. West of the square is the Old Cemetery where many prominent Malmö residents have their graves.

spots.name: Malmö Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Malmö Museum is a municipal and regional museum in Malmö, Sweden. The museum shows exhibitions on technology, shipping, natural history and history. Malmö museum also has an aquarium. The exhibitions are primarily shown on Castle Island (Slottsholmen) and in the Technology & Maritime Museum.

spots.name: Malmö Opera
spots.summary: Malmö Opera is an opera house in Malmö, Sweden. An opera company of the same name presents seasons of opera in this house.

spots.name: Hyllie Water Tower
spots.summary: The Hyllie Water Tower, in the Hyllie district of the Swedish city of Malmö, was designed by the architect Karl Ivar Stål for Kjessler & Mannerstråle and completed in 1973. The tower is white and has the shape of a flying saucer. It is 62 metres (203 ft) high and holds 10,200 cubic metres (360,000 cu ft) of water.

spots.name: Saint John's Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: St. John's Church is a church located near Triangeln in the Innerstaden district of Malmö, Sweden. It was designed by Axel Anderberg in the Jugend style and built in 1903–1907.

spots.name: Malmö Konsthall

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Malmö Konsthall is an exhibition hall located in the center of Malmö, Sweden. It is one of the largest exhibition halls for contemporary art in Europe.

spots.name: Centralposthuset, Malmö
spots.summary: The Central Post Office Building, Malmö, Sweden, is a historic building in the National Romantic style. It was designed by Ferdinand Boberg, one of Sweden’s most prominent architects of his time.

spots.name: Statue of Zlatan
spots.summary: The statue of Zlatan was a statue depicting the Swedish footballer Zlatan Ibrahimović, created by the sculptor Peter Linde at the end of 2017, at the request of the Swedish Football Association.

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Caroli Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Caroli Church is a former church in Malmö, Sweden. It was built in 1880. The church is named after king Charles XI of Sweden.

spots.name: Malmö City Library
spots.summary: Malmö City Library is a municipal public library in Malmö, Sweden, which opened on 12 December 1905. It has 550,000 different media, about 10,000 DVDs and 33,500 music CDs. In 2006, it became the first library in Sweden to lend video games.

names.es: Biblioteca de la ciudad de Malmö

spots.name: Ribersborgs open-air bath
spots.summary: Ribersborg open-air bathhouse is an open-air public bath at a historic wooden pier on Ribersborg beach in Malmö, Sweden, approximately one kilometre southwest of Turning Torso. The bathhouse is open for a skinny dip year round and has separate areas for men and women.

names.ja: リバースボルク野外浴場

spots.name: St. Paul's Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: St. Paul's Church is a church located in the Rörsjöstaden neighbourhood of Malmö, Sweden.

spots.name: Kungsparken
spots.summary: Kungsparken is a park in Malmö, Sweden. It is located in the centre of the city just west of the Malmö City Hall and Malmö District Court and surrounds Malmöhus Castle. Up until 1881 it was known as Slottsparken.

spots.name: Adelgatan
spots.summary: Adelgatan was, together with Östergatan and Västergatan, Malmö's main street from the Middle Ages.

spots.name: Malmö City Theatre
spots.summary: Malmö City Theatre in Malmö, Sweden, is the main theatre of Malmö.

spots.name: Moderna Museet Malmö

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: Moderna Museet Malmö is a museum of modern and contemporary art located in Malmö, Sweden. It is a branch of the state-owned Moderna Museet in Stockholm, with an independent exhibition programme.

spots.name: Folkets park
spots.summary: Park and entertainment venue in the central parts of Malmö. See the terrarium. Ride a pony. Sunbathe. Eat and drink.

spots.name: Slottsträdgården
spots.summary: Located north of Kungsparken and south of Malmöhus Castle. This is one of the city's newest amenities and is an organic community garden, open throughout the year. There are eight themed gardens and a potager. Freshly picked flowers and vegetables are available for purchase in the summer months. There is also a small cafe, run entirely by volunteers.

spots.name: Simhallsbadet, Malmö
spots.summary: Simhallsbadet is a swimming complex in Malmö city, Sweden owned by the Malmö Municipality. It was known as Aq-va-kul 1988–2015. Today it is mainly used by swimming clubs and schools.

spots.name: Point Hyllie

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Point Hyllie is a residential, office and hotel complex in Hyllievång in the district of Hyllie in southwest Malmö.

spots.name: Slottsparken
spots.summary: Slottsparken is a park in Malmö, Sweden established in 1897 and opened for public in 1900. Malmö City Library is located in one corner of the park. Across the canal to the north lies Kungsparken, which was known as Slottsparken until 1881.

spots.name: Drottningtorget
spots.summary: Drottningtorget is a major public square in central Malmö, Sweden. It lies between the main town square and Värnhem. The area dates back to at least the Middle Ages when the Adelgatan, one of the city's main streets, led to it and it became an important peasant trading centre.

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Stadion, Malmö
spots.summary: Stadion, currently known as Eleda Stadion for sponsorship reasons, is a football stadium in Malmö, Sweden and the home of Allsvenskan club Malmö Fotbollförening, commonly known as Malmö FF.

names.ja: スウェドバンク・スタディオン

hours.note: Closed Sun; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Möllevångstorget
spots.summary: South of the city centre, has a bustling open-air market on weekends. The surrounding neighbourhood is full of inexpensive Asian and Middle Eastern shops, restaurants and grocery stores catering to the alternative side of the city, the immigrant population and people who are tired of mainstream commerce. The place to go to for inexpensive to moderate prices of beer.

spots.name: Malmö Stadion
spots.summary: Malmö Stadion, often known simply as Stadion before the construction of the new Stadion between 2007 and 2009, is a defunct multi-purpose stadium in Malmö, Sweden.

names.ja: マルメ・スタディオン

spots.name: Malmö Live
spots.summary: A concert hall opened in August 2015.

spots.name: Ribersborgsstranden
spots.summary: There are several options for outdoor swimming in Malmö. This includes beachparks and seabath facilities with small piers. The largest and most popular venue is Ribersborgstranden beachpark, right in the central parts. Swim, sunbathe or promenade at the 2-km sandy beach in Ribersborgstranden. The beach is child-friendly with sandy stretches, just a short walk from the inner city. In the winter you

spots.name: Gamla Väster

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Between Lilla Torget and Malmöhus. It is a quiet and sophisticated neighbourhood with lots of galleries, design shops and restaurants.

spots.name: Elysée
spots.summary: The main attraction is the all-you-can-eat bouillon fondue (259 kr per person, min. two persons). Choose between beef, pork or chicken with either potatoes or rice on the side. The salad bar is included to the price, but you may also just order the salad bar for 135 kr, all-you-can-eat (all prices as of May 2023). You may also order the reindeer filet.

spots.name: Restaurang Asien

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: An unpretentious looking restaurant that serves delicious Vietnamese food. You'll find it a short walk from Möllevångstorget, down Ystadsgatan. On the menu you will find food like Pho or Vietnamese springrolls. Tasty and reasonably priced.

spots.name: Aras

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Persian restaurant that serves authentic and succulent Persian kebabs on fluffy steamed basmati rice with butter, grilled tomato and raw onion on the side. Don't miss the salade Olivier, Russian salad-Persian style.

spots.name: Özen Allfrukt

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Balkan-style cuisine offering fast food dishes such as Burek, Ćevapčići and Pljeskavica. The Pljeskavica will satiate you for the rest of the day. It's also a grocery store with low prices.

spots.name: Slagthuset

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The city's biggest and best-known nightclub, housed in a former slaughterhouse (hence the name). The facility also includes a performance theatre and restaurants during the day.

spots.name: 1998 Coffee Shop

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu

spots.summary: Has good coffee. Also sells speciality coffee beans, t-shirts, jeans, and other items of clothing. Offers take-away and has a 1990s-inspired seating area. Friendly staff.

spots.name: Ganesha

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: Affordable, decent Indian food served in a canteen-style setting. A menu consists of 2 – 3 choices of vegetables or meat, along with sauce and rice; extras can be added.

spots.name: Vegegården

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Lovely Asian vegetarian restaurant. À la carte and buffet-style. Serves lunch on weekdays and barbecue on weekends. From 68 kr; eat as much as you like.

spots.name: Mello Yello

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: A delicious mix of Swedish and European food. The best view and service is in the one located close to the Turning Torso and the beach (150 kr each).

spots.name: Di Penco

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: An Italian lunch restaurant a short walk from "Triangeln". They serve delicious home made pasta with freshly baked ciabatta bread for only 65 kr.

spots.name: The Vegan Bar

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Nice location, nice food, nice people. They have a wide variety of vegan food. Very good vegan burgers. Food comes fast and quantities are great.

spots.name: Burritofriends

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Supremely delicious, vegan-friendly, and highly customizable. The menu is just great, the ingredients are fresh. The service is friendly.

spots.name: Yukai

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: A calm place with great atmosphere, great sushi and great service. Probably the best Japanese restaurant in town. Mains 64-175 kr.

spots.name: Ses På Paddy's

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Excellent Swedish food, don't let the idea of eating in an Irish bar put you off! Booking is essential in this busy restaurant.

spots.summary: Not quite like a Tokyo tavern, but it still manages to attract visiting Japanese businessmen.

spots.summary: Great Irish pub just off Gustav Adolf's Square.
